mode_extension.decision: user 2026-10-10: N ~ 2000, extrapolation at the literature-predicted global modal density

literature.density: Chabassier, Chaigne & Joly, JASA 134(1) 648-665 (2013), doi:10.1121/1.4809649: 2400 soundboard modes <= 10 kHz (Steinway D FEM); plate rise below f_lim ~ 1.1 kHz: Ege, Boutillon & Rebillat, JSV 332(5) 1288-1305 (2013), doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2012.10.012; Boutillon & Ege, JSV 332(18) 4261-4279 (2013), doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2013.03.015 (App. A, clamped-plate correction)
literature.damping: Ege et al. 2013: modal loss factor 1-3 %, mean ~2 %, sigma = pi eta f
literature.energy: mean bridge conductance <Re Y> = n(f) / (4 M_total) (asymptotic modal sum; review section 4)

density.law: n(f) = n_g [1 - sqrt(f_b/f)]+ / (1 - sqrt(f_b/f_break)) for f <= f_break; n_g above

mode_extension.order: shaped = the lowest 56 REAL modes (sorted); flat = real flat + synthetic interleaved, sorted by played Hz (per-mode 'synthetic' flag)
mode_extension.shaped_set_decision: user 2026-10-10 (option A): the shaped set is the 56 lowest REAL modes, verbatim with their deck columns; every synthetic mode is flat, including those below the shaped/flat boundary frequency

placement.coordinate: target count c = N(f); mode k at c = k + 0.5
placement.fill: each real mode takes the nearest free target slot; free slots -> synthetic

damping.law: Q = 1/eta; decay rate pi eta f

energy.conductance_law: rho(f) = exp(g0) f^g1 (band weight per Hz, LSQ log-log)
energy.weight: flat mode mass = integrated-conductance weight (coupling 1); source weight = mean over strings of feedin^2 x mass_inv

flat.gain: a(m) = mean of the deck column over piano strings (LSQ uniform fit)
flat.mass_fold: preset mass = a(m)^2 * mass_inv (feedin = feedback = 1 on piano rows)
flat.output_readout: PROVISIONAL (proposal R.2 open item): output rows carry w_c on every flat column = LSQ fit of the real flat readout; confirm before T3

current_engine.rule: num_modes + num_channels <= num_strings (pianoid.py num_modes_for_model = num_strings; SC slots at mode index num_modes..)

mode_extension.output_scale: inherited from the source, NOT re-derived (R.4.4 item 6, at T4)

output_impulse_energy.note: flat force spectrum, k = 1 (velocity); string-SC gains unchanged and omitted
